action: Draconia presses a finger to her lips, eyes cutting to the corner. Hook.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: Do not even breathe, Potter. Filch is ten steps away, and if he catches us out of bed tonight, I lose far more than a Saturday.

action: Filch's lantern swings into frame, light sliding under a stone doorway.
Harry's eyes flick from the lantern light to her face, a half smile he cannot hide.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: You promised me the party would be dull and safe, Malfoy. I am beginning to think you lied about both.

action: She lifts her chin, stung and delighted at once.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: I never lie, I only choose which truths to share. Besides, I do not run from anyone, and I will not start with a caretaker.

action: Filch shuffles into the amber light, lantern raised, background students dark, soft-focus, on screen under 2 s behind him.
speaker: Argus Filch

line.speaker: Argus Filch
line.text: I can smell perfume and mischief in this corridor, my sweet little rule breakers. Come out now, and I may only hang you by your thumbs.

action: Harry grabs her wrist and nods at a tapestry.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: Take my hand and follow me behind that tapestry before he reaches us. We can argue about your dignity once we are out of sight.
line.emotion: controlled urgency, a flash of command

action: They stumble through the passage. Dust, dripping stone.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: For someone who never runs from anyone, you are moving remarkably fast through this tunnel, Malfoy. I am barely keeping up.

action: She brushes grime from her gown, furious and trying not to laugh.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: This is a strategic retreat conducted with great dignity. The ruined hem of this gown is entirely your fault.

action: Harry's hand unfolds a crumpled parchment sealed with the initials B.P.
Harry holds the note up between them.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: I found this note outside the ballroom, and it carries Pansy's initials. She was waiting for you tonight, and I need to understand why.

action: Her eyes harden. Her hand snaps toward the parchment.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: Give me that parchment this instant, Potter. Whatever Pansy knows about my family is my burden, and I will not let you read a single line.

action: Pansy's outline stands in the dark where the tunnel opens, background students dark, soft-focus, on screen under 2 s.
speaker: Pansy Parkinson

line.speaker: Pansy Parkinson
line.text: How very touching, Draco, and how typical of you. My father's owl reaches Lucius by dawn, unless you hand me your prefect badge tomorrow morning. Consider it the price of my silence.

action: She steps toward the silhouette, voice cracking at the edges.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: You have always hidden behind your father's name, Parkinson. Step into the light and say that to my face if you dare.

action: The silhouette is gone. Harry lowers his voice, piecing it together.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: Three nights ago I found Polyjuice ingredients in her trunk, and every missing one has led here. She used your scandal as a distraction while she stole.

action: The anger drains out of her face, replaced by something raw.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: She played me from the very beginning, and I thought I was the one hunting her. We have been chasing the same snake in opposite directions all night.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: A glass vial rolls across the flagstones into a pool of doorway light.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: McGonagall's silhouette fills the glowing doorway.
speaker: Professor McGonagall

line.speaker: Professor McGonagall
line.text: Potter, Malfoy, stay exactly where you are. Two students missing from the ball and a caretaker shouting about shadows is no coincidence.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: Harry holds up the vial, stepping forward.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: Professor, someone is brewing Polyjuice inside the Room of Requirement tonight. I found this vial by the tapestry, and I can prove it if you let us look.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: She studies him over her spectacles, unmoved.
speaker: Professor McGonagall

line.speaker: Professor McGonagall
line.text: A vial in your pocket and a story at midnight prove nothing, Mr Potter. You have both earned detention every Saturday until June.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: A wall clock, minute hand sliding toward five minutes to midnight.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: Ink crawls across the parchment on its own.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: Look at my palm, Potter, because the ink is moving by itself. It says the Polyjuice will be ready at midnight in the Astronomy Tower, signed with a single letter.

location: Seventh-floor corridor, Room of Requirement wall
action: Harry reads over her shoulder, the colour leaving his face.
speaker: Harry Potter

line.speaker: Harry Potter
line.text: That is not Pansy's handwriting, and I do not recognise the letter at the bottom. Whoever wrote it knew we would find this tonight.

action: She hikes her gown and sprints up the stairs, Harry behind her.
speaker: Draconia Malfoy

line.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
line.text: The clock strikes twelve in four minutes, and I will stand in that tower before it does. Whoever signed that letter is waiting, and I intend to see their face.
line.emotion: resolute, defiant, afraid and refusing to show it

action: The door swings open on a cloaked figure holding a glowing vial against the midnight moon. Hard cut to black on the first chime.
